entry.label: Entry point
entry.definition: Where the flow starts: a request, command, trigger, event or user action.

step.label: Step
step.definition: Ordinary work: a function, task or process step.

decision.label: Decision
decision.definition: A branch that changes the path; its yellow arrows are the outcomes.

store.label: Data store
store.definition: State that outlives the step: database, file, cache, queue, ledger.

external.label: External
external.definition: Outside the system drawn: third-party API, vendor, OS, another team's service.

async.label: Async
async.definition: Work that continues later or elsewhere: queue, event, background job, callback.

config.label: Config
config.definition: Settings that shape behaviour: env vars, config files, flags, policies.

exit.label: Success exit
exit.definition: Where the flow ends successfully: response sent, value returned, job done.

error.label: Failure
error.definition: Where the flow ends in failure: exception, rejection, non-zero exit.

component.label: Component
component.definition: A part treated as one block: module, package, service, device (maps).

call.label: Calls
call.head: triangle
call.definition: Synchronous hand-off: A passes control or work to B and waits.

return.label: Returns
return.head: chevron
return.definition: A result flowing back to the caller.

branch.label: Branch
branch.head: triangle
branch.definition: One outcome of a decision; the label names the condition.

async.label: Async
async.head: triangle
async.definition: Fire-and-forget: publish, enqueue, schedule. The sender does not wait.

data.label: Reads/writes
data.head: dot
data.definition: Reads from or writes to a data store.

error.label: Error path
error.head: triangle
error.definition: Failure propagating: raise, reject, error response, escalation.

depends.label: Depends on
depends.head: chevron
depends.definition: A relies on B: imports, requires or cannot run without it (maps).

unit.label: Unit
unit.definition: One thing that owns everything inside it: a file, service, machine, team.

area.label: Area
area.definition: A loose collection: a directory, department, network zone, phase.

outside.label: Outside
outside.heading: Outside the system
outside.definition: Actors and systems outside the thing being drawn.
